verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਭਕਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਕਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਏ ਕਉਨ ਪਤਿਤਾਈ ਕੈ॥
verses.translit_en: kavan bhakat kar bhakat vachhal bhe patit paavan bhe kaun patitaiee kai||

en.bdb: O  Lord! what is that worship that has made You the beloved of the worshippers? Which is that apostasy that has made You the forgiver and purifier of the sinners?

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁ ਕਉਨ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਕੈ ਗਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੀ ਭਏ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheen dhukh bha(n)jan bhe su kaun dheenataa kai garab prahaaree bhe kavan baddaiee kai ||

en.bdb: Which is that humility that has made You the allayer of the sufferings of the poor? Which is that ego-filled praise that has made You the destroyer of the pride and arrogance?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਥ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਹਾਈ ਭਏ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰਣ ਹੈ ਕਉਨ ਅਸੁਰਾਈ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kavan sevaa kai naath sevak sahaiee bhe asur sa(n)ghaaran hai kaun asuraiee kai ||

en.bdb: Which is that service of Your slave that has made You his master and You have helped him? Which is that devilish and demonic trait that has made You the destroyer of the demons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਘ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਗਰਬ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਨ ਬਿਰਦ ਮਿਲਉ ਕਵਨ ਕਮਾਈ ਕੈ ॥੬੦੧॥
verses.translit_en: bhagat jugat agh dheenataa garab sevaa jaanau na biradh milau kavan kamaiee kai ||601||

en.bdb: O my Lord! I have not been able to fathom Your duty and nature. Please be kind and tell me by what form of worship and service that can bring humility in me, destroy my ego and apostasy, can I reach you?  (601)
